title: fix(auth): dispatch BUD-01 viewer auth based on path context
body:
## Summary

- `diagnose_viewer_auth_request` always dispatched BUD-01 (kind 24242) events to `validate_viewer_event`, which requires `AuthAction::List`. blob viewer requests (e.g. `/<sha256>.ext`) need `AuthAction::Get`, so valid get-scoped auth was rejected with "Invalid action tag."
- route BUD-01 events through `validate_blob_viewer_event` when the request path contains a blob hash, matching how `viewer_pubkey` in `auth.rs` already dispatches correctly.
- move `blob_hash_from_path` from `auth.rs` to `viewer_auth.rs` as a shared `pub(crate)` helper to avoid duplication.

the live `viewer_pubkey` path in `auth.rs` was already correct. this fix aligns the diagnostic/context path (`media_viewer_context` -> `diagnose_viewer_auth`) with the same logic. NIP-98 (kind 27235) auth is unaffected.

Closes #126

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo test -p blossom-core --locked` passes (99 tests, 0 failures)
- [ ] BUD-01 auth with `['t', 'get']` + `['x', sha256]` succeeds on blob paths (previously rejected)
- [ ] BUD-01 auth with `['t', 'list']` continues to work on non-blob paths (list endpoints)
- [ ] NIP-98 auth (kind 27235) unaffected on all paths
- [ ] unauthenticated requests to non-restricted content unaffected

regression tests added:
- `viewer_auth_diagnostics_accepts_bud01_get_on_blob_path` -- the exact path that was broken
- `viewer_auth_diagnostics_rejects_bud01_list_on_blob_path` -- confirms strict dispatch

title: fix(auth): media_viewer_context rejects BUD-01 get events on blob routes
body:
## Summary

`media_viewer_context` rejects BUD-01 (kind 24242) auth events with `['t', 'get']` on blob GET routes. All viewer handlers (blob, HLS master, HLS content, thumbnail, subtitle, audio, quality variant) use `media_viewer_context` -> `diagnose_viewer_auth` -> `diagnose_viewer_auth_request`, which calls `validate_viewer_event`. For BUD-01 events, this dispatches to `validate_blossom_event(event, AuthAction::List)` -- only accepting `['t', 'list']`.

The correct validation path exists: `validate_blob_viewer_event` -> `validate_blossom_get_event` accepts `['t', 'get']` with hash verification. But it's only reachable through `authenticate_blob_viewer`, which is called by `viewer_pubkey` in `auth.rs` -- a function none of the viewer handlers use.

## Impact

Clients sending BUD-01 get events for age-restricted blob fetches get 401 despite valid auth. divine-web worked around this by switching to NIP-98 (kind 27235) in divinevideo/divine-web#348.

## Fix

`diagnose_viewer_auth_request` should detect blob paths (via `blob_hash_from_path`) and dispatch BUD-01 events to `validate_blob_viewer_event` instead of `validate_viewer_event`, matching the logic already in `viewer_pubkey`.

~4 lines changed. No breaking changes -- strictly additive. NIP-98 unaffected, BUD-01 list events unaffected, non-blob paths unaffected.

## Relevant code

- `src/viewer_auth.rs:271` -- `diagnose_viewer_auth_request` calls `validate_viewer_event`
- `src/viewer_auth.rs:146` -- `validate_viewer_event` uses `AuthAction::List` for BUD-01
- `src/viewer_auth.rs:162` -- `validate_blob_viewer_event` uses `AuthAction::Get` for BUD-01 (correct)
- `src/auth.rs:36-55` -- `viewer_pubkey` does the right blob path dispatch but isn't used by viewer handlers

title: feat: Implement actual thumbnail extraction
body:
### Summary

`extract_video_thumbnail` in `cloud-functions/process-blob/main.py` is a stub: it logs a TODO and always returns `None`. Video uploads therefore never get a real thumbnail for moderation or metadata until this is implemented.

### Problem / Motivation

  `extract_video_thumbnail` in `cloud-functions/process-blob/main.py` is still a
   stub: it logs a TODO and always returns `None`. For `video/*` uploads that means:
  - No JPEG frame is produced or uploaded for moderation.
  - The pipeline falls through to `update_metadata(..., status='pending', ...)` instead of
  running Vision SafeSearch on a thumbnail.
  - Downstream UX (thumbnails at the edge, metadata `thumbnail` field, deleting a thumbnail
   when content is restricted) cannot behave as intended until real extraction exists.

### Proposed Approach

  1. Implement frame extraction from the source video (e.g. `ffmpeg` or equivalent),
  writing a single JPEG to a temp file, then uploading it to the same GCS bucket as the
  source object.
  2. Return the resulting GCS object key from `extract_video_thumbnail` so existing callers
   stay unchanged: `check_image_safety(bucket_name, thumbnail_path)` already uses
  `gs://{bucket}/{blob_name}` for Vision.
  3. Align the **uploaded object key** with how the app serves thumbnails (`{sha256}.jpg`
  vs the current stub `thumbnails/{blob_name}`) so Fastly/Rust (`parse_thumbnail_path`,
  `download_thumbnail`) and the metadata webhook stay consistent.
  4. Extend the `Dockerfile` or chosen runtime
   to include whatever binary/library is required; today only `c2patool` is installed—no
  `ffmpeg` yet.
  5. Ensure extracted `.jpg` objects are ignored by `_is_generated_derivative` / naming
  rules so processing does not recurse on generated thumbnails.
  6. Add or adjust tests around `extract_video_thumbnail` success/failure and the video
  branch of `process_blob_event`.

### Additional Context

  - TODO location: `extract_video_thumbnail`
   https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-blossom/blob/55caf2c5774548f01ed30ed795d384f7d82e976a/cloud-functions/process-blob/main.py#L416
  - Video flow: `process_blob_event` calls extraction, then moderation +
  `handle_moderation_result` with optional `thumbnail_path` for cleanup on flag.
  - Operational limits: gunicorn `--timeout 300` in the Dockerfile; large videos may need
  download/size/time guards analogous to C2PA limits.

title: fix(transcoder): write empty VTT stub when provider returns no transcribable speech
body:
## Summary

Silent / music-only / non-speech videos used to surface as HTTP 500 from the transcoder, leaving no VTT object in GCS at all. The edge then served `GET /{hash}/vtt` as **202 \"in_progress\" forever**, blocking any downstream consumer that polls until completion.

This PR makes the transcoder write a minimal `WEBVTT\n\n` stub for the no-speech case so the edge serves **200 with no cues** — \"transcribed, no captions\" — instead of leaving the request in pending state indefinitely.

## What changed

- New helper `is_empty_transcript_normalize_error` distinguishes \"normalize rejected the response because it was empty\" from real provider failures.
- `process_transcribe` now substitutes `ParsedVtt::empty(...)` when that classifier matches, parallel to how the existing `transcript_drop_reason` guards (LowProviderConfidence, LowSignalHeuristic, LoopHallucination, ImplausibleTextDensity) already do.
- `normalize_transcript_to_vtt` itself is unchanged — it still returns `Err` for empty inputs (existing tests assert this on purpose, so the raw JSON envelope can never accidentally render as a VTT cue).
- Real provider failures (5xx, timeouts, JSON parse errors, missing config) are NOT reclassified.

## Why this surfaced now

During the Parakeet TDT v3 backfill (#123, merged earlier today), ~1,051 of 5,932 user-uploaded videos hit this code path because the previous Gemini-2.5-Pro pipeline had been hallucinating fake transcripts on silent/music audio. Backfill correctly deleted those poisoned VTTs but, because of this bug, never wrote a stub in their place — those videos are currently stuck in 202 in_progress state.

Once this lands, the next access to those videos will trigger fresh transcription, hit the empty-stub path, and resolve to a proper 200/empty.

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo test` — 116/116 passing (was 113; 3 new for the classifier across positive and negative cases)
- [x] Image built (`gcr.io/.../divine-transcoder:5269559-emptyvtt`) — ready to roll out via `gcloud run services update --image` once approved
- [x] Existing `normalize_transcript_to_vtt` tests for empty/whitespace/null inputs still assert `is_err()` and pass — the strict normalize behavior is preserved
- [ ] Post-deploy verification: pick one previously-stuck hash, hit `/transcribe`, then `gsutil cat gs://.../vtt/main.vtt` and confirm it's the `WEBVTT\n\n` stub
